name: LkoMetro — Lucknow Metro
description: Unofficial companion app for the Lucknow Metro Red Line. Provides route planning, live train tracking, fare calculation and offline station search.

actions.name: Plan a metro route
actions.description: Open the route planner to calculate travel time and fare between two stations on the Lucknow Metro Red Line.

actions.name: Search for a station or landmark
actions.description: Search for any of the 21 Red Line stations or nearby landmarks by name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Station or landmark name to search for

actions.name: View live train positions
actions.description: See real-time simulated positions of all active trains on the Red Line.
